purpose: This BRS document outlines the business requirements for the software product, focusing on user functionality, system capabilities, and operational constraints.
scope: The system covers the creation and management of 3D parametric models, 2D sketch editing, 3D feature extrusion, assembly project management, and visualization settings. It also includes tools for geometric entity manipulation and bidirectional synchronization between 2D and 3D components.
user_classes: Role Name: Designer - Responsible for creating and managing 3D parametric models and 2D sketches
Role Name: Assembler - Manages assembly projects and component manipulation
Role Name: Viewer - Accesses and modifies 3D and 2D sketches and visual settings
constraints: Preservation of geometric relationships during edits
assumptions: Users will be familiar with basic 2D sketch creation and editing
The system will maintain data integrity during edits and extrusions
Users will be able to switch between 2D and 3D modeling modes
